verdict.rationale: Floot's own docs say apps get built-in sign-in with Google or Microsoft through OAuth that Floot brokers, so no developer account is needed. That covers the social-provider half of the story as a first-party capability. Email/password sign-up and login are not evidenced, and neither is explicit scaffolding of sign-up and login screens; missing for 10: email-based sign-up/login, documentation of scaffolded auth flows and screens, additional social providers beyond Google/Microsoft, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add user sign-up and login (email, social providers) scaffolded by the builder

citations.quote: Sign in with Google or Microsoft through OAuth that Floot brokers for you — no developer account of your own to register.
Describe the integration you want to your AI assistant, and the endpoints, database tables, and screens get built for you.
